stage: After source discovery leads, before exact-capture eligibility adjudication or any v10 prediction. Not ex ante to discovery.

rules.name: directly_corrected_dependent
rules.rule: Record whether the correction explicitly replaces the dependent conclusion too. Preserve every supported direct correction in the direct and dependency conditions. Such a case may satisfy admission but is a redundant-propagation control, not evidence of incremental propagation gain.

rules.name: original_documents
rules.rule: Capturing an actual versioned old document today supports document-version comparison, not reconstructed historical first-public availability.

rules.name: full_source_limits
rules.rule: Full source documents cannot be silently shortened to fit the pinned 4096-token reader. Any selected-state replay uses source-adjudicated inputs and reports itself as annotation-conditioned support materialization, not full-source reader QA.

rules.name: claims_and_context
rules.rule: Preserve changed measurement selections and scope differences. A same-experiment label does not make changed selected events identical; source review decides representability.

rules.name: outcome_denominators
rules.rule: Report discovered, captured, eligible, replayed and predicted separately. No model execution means no empirical QA test, neither a pass nor evidence of a failed algorithm.
